## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain relevant checks that were not run.
For UI changes, include screenshots and check keyboard access, narrow width, and offline behavior where affected.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe changes to dependencies, the artifact format, measurement semantics, or public behavior. Write “None” if unaffected.
Keep recorded captures, measured reports, and archived runner sources unchanged; record new experiments separately.

- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect user-visible changes, where applicable.
- [ ] Behavioral fixes have relevant regression coverage, where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, local datasets, or runtime caches are included.
